comparison.objective: Fill a chemical day tank to a mark and close the transfer valve; candidate tunes an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve operation and feedback-based liquid-level control versus hex-key alignment, collar adjustment, counterholding, and torque-controlled fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Valve must be opened, level brought to the mark, and valve closed without overflow; candidate requires isolated adjustment and two safe carriage stops. Level tolerance, flow rate, and spill threshold are unstated.
comparison.reason: Both involve feedback and final shutoff/locking, but fluid transfer control is a meaningfully different tested ability.
